d: A skeletal humanoid species with bleached bone-white plating. Hollow, glowing, crimson red eye sockets. Appears as an ancient, undead entity. Large, hulking build with exposed ribs and a protruding jaw. Wears tattered, dark grey rags around the waist. Possesses four skeletal claws per hand and a short, jagged, bone-white tail. BODY COLOR: bleached bone-white.
